name: head children
eval: (function(){var h=document.querySelector('#head');var hb=h.getBoundingClientRect();var out=['head h='+Math.round(hb.height)+' scrollH='+h.scrollHeight];Array.prototype.forEach.call(h.children,function(c){var r=c.getBoundingClientRect();out.push((c.id||c.className)+' h='+Math.round(r.height)+' scrollH='+c.scrollHeight+' bottomInHead='+Math.round(r.bottom-hb.top)+(c.scrollHeight>c.clientHeight+1?'  OVERFLOWS':''))});return out.join(' | ')})()

name: brand block
eval: (function(){var b=document.querySelector('#brand');var bb=b.getBoundingClientRect();var out=['brand h='+Math.round(bb.height)+' scrollH='+b.scrollHeight];Array.prototype.forEach.call(b.children,function(c){var r=c.getBoundingClientRect();out.push((c.className||c.tagName)+' h='+Math.round(r.height))});return out.join(' | ')})()
